selection.algorithm: SHA256 domain rank + alternating domain-2 pools + SHA256 machine rank + globally distinct initial domain-1 IDs
selection.hash_encoding: UTF-8; lowercase hex; sort by (digest, exact string)
selection.prefix_QC_limit: elapsed seconds [0,345600), the first 50% of the fixed eight-day window
selection.replacement_rule: Before suffix inspection, failed primary prefix-QC is replaced by the first eligible fixed-order reserve of its own role; no post-lock outcome-based replacement or cross-role reassignment.
selection.independence_caveat: Distinct machine and initial failure-domain identifiers reduce overlap; all machines share one production cluster and are not proven statistically independent.

resampling.statistic: arithmetic mean of valid unique CPU observations
resampling.label: right edge; available only when that bin is complete
resampling.max_source_timestamp: strictly less than emitted bin end
resampling.threshold_status: prespecified planning gates, conditional on confirming nominal 10-second cadence on development-prefix data

preprocessing.duplicate_rule: Remove exact duplicate full rows with counters; conflicting CPU values at the same machine/timestamp invalidate that bin.
preprocessing.invalid_cpu_rule: Nonfinite, missing, -1, 101 or other outside-[0,100] CPU readings cannot contribute; count them, do not clip or fill.
preprocessing.gap_rule: No interpolation, forward fill, backfill, compressed time or longest-segment selection. Failed bins fail the fixed-window stream.
preprocessing.sorting: Per-machine chronological sort before causal replay if raw file order is not chronological; no value-based transformations using future samples.
preprocessing.constant_or_zero_streams: Retain if valid; MAPE/MASE require their own validity flags.

partitions.development_use: Select global settings on development machines only with chronological fit/validation targets.
partitions.confirmation_use: After global settings freeze, fit experts/scalers on each confirmation machine's allowed first-70% prefix. Do not search/tune hyperparameters on confirmation machines; warm-up supplies only prespecified online state.

forecasting.target: next/future complete five-minute mean CPU utilization

prelock_prefix_only: Insufficient fixed-prefix coverage or failed 300-second bins
Conflicting duplicate CPU readings invalidate required bins
Invalid schema, negative/nonfinite timestamps or incompatible units
exclusions.postlock: Late quality faults are recorded as failed/incomplete confirmation streams, never replaced using suffix quality or forecasting errors.
forbidden_selection_criteria: Confirmation-period CPU distribution, drift pattern or model error
Selecting an easier or higher-variance confirmation suffix
Choosing the longest clean full-series segment

resource_plan.streaming_strategy: Verify whole compressed usage archive hash, then stream tar/gzip and filter only nominated machine IDs. Keep confirmation suffix values sealed.
resource_plan.network_download_cap_note: Only metadata and 4096 usage-header bytes read in M2; full 1.65-GiB machine table acquisition is a future explicitly staged step.

notes: M1 remains unchanged and is not an external-data ingestion tool.
Do not start M3 from this planning manifest.
If eight-day continuity or cadence gates fail, version the data protocol before any confirmation suffix inspection; never silently shrink the chosen window.
